arxiv-1705-00636.title: Well-posedness of stochastic second grade fluids
arxiv-1705-00636.creator: Nikolai Chemetov
arxiv-1705-00636.description: Abstract The theory of turbulent Newtonian fluids turns out that the choice of the boundary condition is a relevant issue, since it can modify the behavior of the fluid by creating or avoiding a strong boundary layer. In this work we study stochastic second grade fluids filling a two-dimensional bounded domain, with the Navier-slip boundary condition (with friction).

arxiv-1904-03326.title: 360 Panorama Synthesis from a Sparse Set of Images with Unknown Field of View
arxiv-1904-03326.creator: Julius Surya Sumantri, In Kyu Park
arxiv-1904-03326.description: Abstract 360° images represent scenes captured in all possible viewing directions and enable viewers to navigate freely around the scene thereby providing an immersive experience. Conversely, conventional images represent scenes in a single viewing direction with a small or limited field of view (FOV).

arxiv-2211-04293.title: EVALUATION OF COLOR ANOMALY DETECTION IN MULTISPECTRAL IMAGES FOR SYNTHETIC APERTURE SENSING
arxiv-2211-04293.creator: Francis Seits, Indrajit Kurmi, Oliver Bimber *
arxiv-2211-04293.description: Abstract In this article we evaluate unsupervised anomaly detection methods in multispectral images obtained with a wavelength-independent synthetic aperture sensing technique, called Airborne Optical Sectioning (AOS). With a focus on search and rescue missions that apply drones to locate missing or injured persons in dense forest and require real-time operation, we evaluate runtime vs. quality of these methods.

arxiv-2306-12578.title: Tree-level UV completions for N R N_{R} SMEFT d = 6 d=6 and d = 7 d=7 operators
arxiv-2306-12578.creator: Rebeca Beltrán, Ricardo Cepedello, Martin Hirsch
arxiv-2306-12578.description: Abstract We study ultra-violet completions for operators in standard model effective field theory extended with right-handed neutrinos ( N R N_{R} SMEFT). Using a diagrammatic method, we generate systematically lists of possible tree-level completions involving scalars, fermions or vectors for all operators at d = 6 d=6 and d = 7 d=7 , which contain at least one right-handed neutrino.

arxiv-2408-03465.title: Algorithms for the Diverse- k k -SAT problem: the geometry of satisfying assignments
arxiv-2408-03465.creator: Per Austrin, Ioana O. Bercea, Mayank Goswami, Nutan Limaye, Adarsh Srinivasan
arxiv-2408-03465.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Per Austrin, Ioana O. Bercea, Mayank Goswami, Nutan Limaye, Adarsh Srinivasan. Given a k k -CNF formula and an integer s ≥ 2 s\geq 2 , we study algorithms that obtain s s solutions to the formula that are as dispersed as possible. For s = 2 s=2 , this problem of computing the diameter of a k k -CNF formula was initiated by Creszenzi and Rossi, who showed strong hardness results even for k = 2 k=2 .

arxiv-2504-18961.title: Rethinking Feature Fusion in Multimodal CTR Prediction
arxiv-2504-18961.creator: Junjie Zhou
arxiv-2504-18961.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Junjie Zhou. With the rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), an increasing number of researchers are exploring their application in recommendation systems. However, the high latency associated with large models presents a significant challenge for such use cases. The EReL@MIR workshop provided a valuable opportunity to experiment with various approaches aimed at improving the efficiency of multimodal representation learning for information retrieval tasks. As part of the competition’s requirements, participants were mandated to submit a technical report detailing their methodologies and findings.

arxiv-2506-12253.title: Four-Loop Renormalisation of Chiral Gauge Theories with Non-Anticommuting γ 5 \gamma_{5} in the BMHV Scheme
arxiv-2506-12253.creator: Andreas von Manteuffel, Dominik Stöckinger, Matthias Weißwange, [2em] Institut für Theoretische Physik, Universität RegensburgUniversitätstraße 31, DE-93040 Regensburg, Germany, [0.5em] Institut für Kern- und Teilchenphysik, TU DresdenZellescher Weg 19, DE-01069 Dresden, Germany
arxiv-2506-12253.description: Abstract We present the complete 4-loop renormalisation of an Abelian chiral gauge theory in the Breitenlohner-Maison / ‘t Hooft-Veltman (BMHV) scheme. Employing a non-anticommuting γ 5 \gamma_{5} in dimensional regularisation, we determine the full set of symmetry restoring counterterms from the quantum action principle.

arxiv-2506-23921.title: The Trilemma of Truth in Large Language Models
arxiv-2506-23921.creator: Germans Savcisens, Tina Eliassi-Rad
arxiv-2506-23921.description: Abstract We often attribute human characteristics to large language models (LLMs) and claim that they “know” certain things. LLMs have an internal probabilistic knowledge that represents information retained during training. How can we assess the veracity of this knowledge? We examine two common methods for probing the veracity of LLMs and discover several assumptions that are flawed.

arxiv-2507-13761.title: Innocence in the Crossfire : Roles of Skip Connections in Jailbreaking Visual Language Models Thanks: This work was supported by Anusandhan National Research Foundation (CRG/2023/001351).
arxiv-2507-13761.creator: Palash Nandi, Maithili Joshi, Tanmoy Chakraborty
arxiv-2507-13761.description: Abstract Language models are highly sensitive to prompt formulations — small changes in input can drastically alter their output. This raises a critical question: To what extent can prompt sensitivity be exploited to generate inapt content ? In this paper, we investigate how discrete components of prompt design influence the generation of inappropriate content in Visual Language Models (VLMs).

arxiv-2511-22207.title: An algorithm to compute upper bounds of dimensions for Siegel Modular Forms of Prime Level and Arbitrary Nebentypus Thanks: We thank Professor Cris Poor and David Yuen for fruitful email correspondence in the initial stage of the project.
arxiv-2511-22207.creator: Debargha Banerjee, Dron Airon, Pranjal Vishwakarma, and Ronit Debnath
arxiv-2511-22207.description: Abstract . We describe an algorithmic method to determine the image of restriction maps for Siegel modular forms with arbitrary characters and arbitrary weight. A program has been implemented in the mathematical software Java to compute the Fourier expansion of the image of these restriction maps for Siegel modular forms of genus two.

doe-osti-3398564-improving-the-performan.title: Improving the Performance of NEML2 with Modern Graph Compilation Backends
doe-osti-3398564-improving-the-performan.creator: Hu, Gary (Tianchen), Messner, Mark C.
doe-osti-3398564-improving-the-performan.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. NEML2 vectorizes constitutive-model evaluation for large-scale multiphysics simulation, using PyTorch as its tensor backend so that a batch of material-point updates runs on CPU or GPU through a single implementation. In the two prior reports in this series it was a C++-native li

pmc-10597180.title: Health inequalities in type 2 diabetes: contributions of exposures in the residential environment
pmc-10597180.creator: J D Albers, A Koster, B Sezer, R Meisters, M T Schram, SJPM Eussen, NHTM Dukers, CDA Stehouwer, J Lakerveld, H Bosma
pmc-10597180.description: BackgroundPeople with lower socioeconomic position (SEP) have higher risk of type 2 diabetes (T2D). Besides genetic predisposition, the exposome shapes this risk. This includes exposures in the residential environment. We explored the relationships between SEP, the residential food environment, walkability, greenspace, and T2D.MethodsCross-sectional and longitudinal data from 9188 participants were analyzed.

pmc-11320879.title: M2-like tumor-associated macrophage-secreted CCL2 facilitates gallbladder cancer stemness and metastasis
pmc-11320879.creator: Weihong Chen, Mingyuan Chen, Lingju Hong, Abudukeremu Xiahenazi, Maotuan Huang, Nanhong Tang, Xinyue Yang, Feifei She, Yanling Chen
pmc-11320879.description: BackgroundThe predominant immune cells in solid tumors are M2-like tumor-associated macrophages (M2-like TAMs), which significantly impact the promotion of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in tumors, enhancing stemness and facilitating tumor invasion and metastasis. However, the contribution of M2-like TAMs to tumor progression in gallbladder cancer (GBC) is partially known.

pmc-11349979.title: Development and validation of a new scoring system to discriminate between uncomplicated and complicated appendicitis
pmc-11349979.creator: Mikito Mori, Kiyohiko Shuto, Chihiro Kosugi, Kazuo Narushima, Atsushi Hirano, Akihiro Usui, Hiroyuki Nojima, Mihono Hirota, Tetsutaro Sazuka, Masato Yamazaki, Takashi Fujino, Kazuto Yamazaki, Hiroaki Shimizu, Keiji Koda
pmc-11349979.description: A scoring system to discriminate between uncomplicated and complicated appendicitis is beneficial to determine the optimal treatment for acute appendicitis. We developed a scoring system to discriminate between uncomplicated and complicated appendicitis and assessed the clinical usefulness of the scoring system using external validation. A total of 299 patients with acute appendicitis were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-11403994.title: YAP activation is robust to dilution†
pmc-11403994.creator: Ian Jones, Mar Arias-Garcia, Patricia Pascual-Vargas, Melina Beykou, Lucas Dent, Tara Pal Chaudhuri, Theodoros Roumeliotis, Jyoti Choudhary, Julia Sero, Chris Bakal
pmc-11403994.description: The concentration of many transcription factors exhibits high cell-to-cell variability due to differences in synthesis, degradation, and cell size. Whether the functions of these factors are robust to fluctuations in concentration, and how this may be achieved, is poorly understood.

pmc-11429208.title: Diversity and Life History Traits of Native Weed Communities in Agricultural Areas: A Case Study in Eastern China
pmc-11429208.creator: Guoqi Chen, Zeyue Huang, Kai An, Yang Chen, Jiahao Xue, Robert Henry
pmc-11429208.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryPlant invasion represents a significant global ecological challenge, and effective management of invasive species requires robust weed risk assessment systems. These systems predominantly rely on understanding the relationships between life history traits and weed occurrence. In this study, we conducted a survey of native weed communities across 666 field sites in agricultural areas of Yangzhou City, China, covering a longitudinal range of 0.86°, a latitudinal range of 0.84°, and an altitude below 100 m.

pmc-11712412.title: Are exercise classes for older people, including those with dementia, located in areas with the greatest need in the North East of England?
pmc-11712412.creator: Ríona Mc Ardle, Lucy Foster, Annabelle Long, Lisa Alcock
pmc-11712412.description: BackgroundApproximately 944,000 people are living with dementia in the UK (∼0.8% of the population). The World Health Organisation consider dementia a public health priority. Efforts to prevent dementia and to decelerate its progression to dependency/disability are vital.Promoting physical activity (e.g. exercise classes) can support dementia prevention and once diagnosed, support independence.

pmc-12529363.title: Differences between male and female mortality in Colombia: a population-based analysis since 1980
pmc-12529363.creator: Oscar Espinosa, Adrian D. Smith, Valeria Bejarano, Johnattan García-Ruiz
pmc-12529363.description: SummaryBackgroundGlobally, women have consistently exhibited lower mortality and higher life expectancy than men. While this sex gap is well-documented in high-income countries, evidence from Latin America remains scarce. Colombia's history of armed conflict and inequality presents a unique context to examine sex differences in mortality.

pmc-12578888.title: Immunometabolic and brain structural alterations mediate increased risk of brain diseases in rheumatoid arthritis patients
pmc-12578888.creator: Siyu He, Zeyu Li, Feng Zeng, Yifei Jin, Wei Zhang, Xinyi Chen, Zequn Zhang, Wei Cheng, Linbo Wang, Wenze Xiao, Qiyong Mei
pmc-12578888.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is associated with an increased risk of brain diseases, yet the underlying biological mechanisms remain poorly understood. Using data from the UK Biobank, including blood-based biomarkers, brain imaging, and diagnostic records, we investigated the roles of immunometabolic and brain structure alterations in the link between RA and brain diseases.

pmc-13282845.title: Implementation of the kidney protection strategy in critically ill patients with acute kidney injury – a multi-center prospective cohort study
pmc-13282845.creator: Mahan Sadjadi, Matteo Marcello, Andrea Köhler, Fabian Perschinka, Sebastian Schauflinger, Michael Joannidis, István Vadász, Faeq Husain-Syed, Margreet Klop-Riehl, Peter Pickkers, Gianluca Villa, Tobias Nagel, Eike Bormann, Hendrik Booke, Ludwig Maximilian Schöne, Thilo von Groote, Moritz J Mertes, John A Kellum, Christian Strauß, Alexander Zarbock

pmc-13379996.title: Establishment and characterization of a mouse model of cisplatin-induced olfactory aversion
pmc-13379996.creator: Haruto Nakano, Yoshihisa Koyama, Koh Shinoda, Shoichi Shimada
pmc-13379996.description: Chemotherapy-induced sensory alterations, including changes in taste and smell, have been reported as adverse effects of anticancer treatments. However, olfactory aversion has received little attention, and its underlying mechanisms remain unclear, limiting effective preventive or therapeutic strategies. Therefore, chemotherapy-induced olfactory aversion was investigated using cisplatin, a widely used anticancer drug.

pmc-13654370.title: Tetanus after trauma despite post-exposure prophylaxis with human tetanus immunoglobulin: A case report
pmc-13654370.creator: Xuan Chen, Xiu Liu, Haijun Cao, Jianxia Zhang, Si Liu
pmc-13654370.description: Tetanus is an acute, life-threatening disease caused by Clostridium tetani infection through breaches in the skin or mucous membranes, typically following traumatic injury. While human tetanus immunoglobulin (HTIG) is the preferred passive immunizing agent, documented cases of prophylaxis failure are rare despite theoretical possibilities. We present a case of generalized tetanus that developed 1 month after HTIG administration following trauma.
